protocol_correction: Before any canonical-successor results were produced, the secondary metric was aligned to the editing V2 gate: balance joint semantic cells rather than operator families. Family-balanced metrics remain diagnostics.
purpose: Select or reject the completed RingCore-V1 editing checkpoints using the molecular process actually deployed: the canonical productive embedded jump chain.

scientific_object.trained_law: normalized executable-mark law, except bond_reroute is already grouped within its canonical graft-successor fiber
scientific_object.evaluated_law: pushforward through the production executor and canonical_state_key, summed by the production segmented-successor implementation
scientific_object.self_events: reported as virtual mass and excluded before conditioning on a productive molecular jump
scientific_object.immediate_backtracks: legal molecular successors in the base Markov kernel; a history-aware controller may suppress them only by augmenting state or declaring a wrapper
scientific_object.hazard: reported separately and never used to select the fixed-budget editing checkpoint

run.inventory_note: The checked-in diagnostics inventory is the exact immutable freezer output. Execution must recompute its self-hash and require frozen_inventory_sha256 before resolving any snapshot.

validation_data.record_sampling: production HierarchicalMarkSampler: layer by frozen weight, then uniform over nonempty path-length bins, then uniform record within bin

progress_sampling.terminal_rows: included for hazard diagnostics and excluded from successor NLL

production_law.stream_prefix_rule: the 4096-row panel is the exact prefix of the 16384-row panel
production_law.expansion_trigger: expand before selection if the top two primary-metric checkpoints have a paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval containing zero, any active family has fewer than 64 nonterminal examples, or a hard-gate estimate is numerically inconclusive
production_law.checkpoint_coverage: every snapshot is scored on the same final panel size

family_forensics.selection_role: capability safeguards and diagnosis only; never substitute its balanced distribution for the production-law primary metric

semantic_cells.cell_id_rule: deterministic versioned encoder over every required axis; no result-dependent merging
semantic_cells.balance_rule: importance-weighted canonical-successor NLL within each frozen nonempty cell, then equal mean over cells

reported_metrics.primary: importance-weighted production-law canonical-successor NLL, conditioned on a nonterminal teacher event
reported_metrics.secondary: equal mean of importance-weighted canonical-successor NLL across frozen joint semantic cells
aggregate: family-balanced canonical-successor NLL as a diagnostic only
fraction of states with any aliased successor
fraction of teacher successors with alias multiplicity greater than one

all_checkpoints: checkpoint SHA-256 and provenance match the frozen inventory
production capability signature matches RingCore-V1 exactly
every nonterminal teacher successor is present exactly once after canonical grouping
every enumerated legal mark executes successfully
every nonterminal successor row is finite, nonnegative, distinct and normalized
no canonical self event appears as a productive successor
ring_system_grow has zero legal marks and zero probability
checkpoint_adequacy: all nine active families have finite successor metrics on at least 256 fixed forensic examples
each active family has positive mean learned-versus-uniform canonical log-likelihood advantage
the one-sided paired 95% bootstrap lower bound on that advantage is positive; if initially ambiguous, expand that family to 1024 examples before deciding
cycle_attach ring opening and bond_reroute graft both pass the same successor-level rule; mark-level top-k cannot waive this gate
held-out validation transport beats uniform canonical rewriting before a checkpoint is frozen for downstream controller experiments

selection_rule.eligible_set: checkpoints passing every structural and capability gate
selection_rule.statistical_tie: paired 95% bootstrap interval for the primary NLL difference contains zero
selection_rule.second: minimum balanced-semantic-cell secondary metric among statistically tied checkpoints
explicitly_forbidden: raw hazard-inclusive GM loss as the editing selector
family top-k as the sole capability criterion
changing panel seeds, thresholds, weights, or expansion rules after canonical results are inspected

decision_outcomes.existing_checkpoint: freeze only if at least one snapshot passes all gates
decision_outcomes.retraining: required if every snapshot fails ring opening, graft, another active-family safeguard, or validation learned-versus-uniform transport
decision_outcomes.repaired_run_final_evaluation: use a new sealed final holdout or external benchmark because current final-test aggregates have already been inspected
